metadata.description: A 3D isometric, cutaway voxel map of Fortulose Manor: an old mostly abandoned mansion deep in Route 9 forest, wrapped in purple fog. The map emphasizes the spooky manor silhouette, broken gate, dead woods, stacked floors, rooflines, balcony slope, and interior Rotom chase landmarks rather than aqueduct terrain.

inspiration.summary: Fortulose Manor is the haunted mansion from Pokémon Brick Bronze. It is reached through dead trees off Route 9; candles can turn purple for Litwick, the interior is full of Ghost encounters, and a Rotom sidequest sends the player through appliances, a red-book/wardrobe transition to 1/F, a balcony slope to 2/F, and a Game Boy finale.

landmarks: broken Route 9 gate and bent iron bars
purple fog forecourt with dead trees and gravestones
cracked stone path and front porch
ground-floor foyer with broken grand staircase
bottom-left music room with flashing jukebox and instruments
red-book bedroom and glowing wardrobe transition
dining room with purple teacups and candle hooks
first-floor Game Boy / Rotom electric chamber
front balcony with Dusk Ball marker
right-side slope from 1/F balcony to attic / 2/F
attic storage under broken slate roof with Dusk Stone marker
collapsed rear tower and stepped purple-black roofs
mapNotes: groundLevelY=5 follows the Greywater Aqueduct convention: y=0..4 form the terrain/foundation stack and tokens stand at y=5 on normal ground
transparent purple fog and glow voxels are non-blocking set dressing
no trainers are placed because the reference location is an abandoned haunted manor
roof and upper floors are intentionally cut away in places to read well from an isometric camera
